The i-Care team prides itself on the compassionate and friendly atmosphere that we have created within our clinic. We know that visits to the veterinary hospital can be stressful, especially when your animal is sick, and we try to minimize this stress as much as possible. We are a locally owned clinic that strives to deliver a caring and personalized experience for both our clients and patients.

Proudly serving Central Vancouver Island

Providing primary care veterinary services for the Coombs, Errington, Qualicum Beach, Parksville, Nanaimo, and Port Alberni regions.

Our YouTube channel is a way for us to pull back the curtain and let clients and potential team members see the dedication, passion and love our team has for the care of your animal family members. We also hope to educate clients about pet health care so that you can provide the care your animal friends and family need.
